text:
45°C outside. 30°C in the bedroom. No AC. A 250-year-old haveli in Bikaner.

The trick was the hole in the middle: the aangan. A small, deep, shaded courtyard keeps the rooms in shade, 70 cm walls delay the heat by about 10 hours so it lands at night, and the courtyard keeps air moving.

The courtyard itself hit 43°C. The rooms around it did not.

Would you give up one room in your flat for a courtyard like this? #Aangan
